The '''Agon system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Ash Worlds/Legends|Ash Worlds]] sector in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] which contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Agon Nine]].
